rationale: Substantial new movement occurred this round (disaggregated cost figure, 2030 horizon conceded by management, dividend/buyback freeze closed by Family Holding, a concrete bounded-process proposal), but the central contested issue—whether a verified shortfall ever permits closures, and how many bounded negotiation rounds precede that—remains genuinely unresolved with parties still actively narrowing the gap (State/Holding's 'information not authorization' vs Investors' 'two bounded rounds then decide' vs Works Council/Union's 'no closures ever'). Since positions are still shifting substantively round-to-round, further negotiation is likely to produce more resolution rather than mere repetition.
